description: This file defines FastAPI routes for matchmaking operations, including enqueueing and dequeueing players for quick-play, and starting matches from queues. It interacts with Redis, a database via SQLAlchemy, and external matchmaking services.

methods.name: AsyncSession _require_db_session(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Ensures an active database session; currently just returns the session passed in.

methods.name: int _maybe_get_mmr(session: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Fetches the player's MMR (matchmaking rating) from the database, defaulting to 1000 if not found.

methods.name: QuickPlayEnqueueResponse quickplay_enqueue( request: Request, body: QuickPlayEnqueueRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to enqueue the authenticated user into a quick-play matchmaking queue, with idempotency support.

methods.name: QuickPlayDequeueResponse quickplay_dequeue( request: Request, body: QuickPlayDequeueRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to remove the user from the quick-play queue, with idempotency support.

methods.name: MatchStartResponse quickplay_try_start( request: Request, queue: str = "unranked", desired_players: int = 4, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)] = None, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)] = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to attempt to start a match from the queue by matching N players, and persisting the match to the database.
